summary: A hero steps on a floor fire trap. JavaScript preflight_dotrap rejects FIRE_TRAP before trap.c:trapeffect_fire_trap can call the missing dofiretrap(NULL) helper. Port the complete trap.c:dofiretrap function and wire all active callers, then admit the hero fire-trap arm while preserving the existing monster arm.

source.branch: trap.c:trapeffect_fire_trap hero arm (1729-1737) marks the trap and calls trap.c:dofiretrap(NULL) (4233-4314). In this v11 recording an unresistant hero with a worn cloak triggers the floor trap at step 15; C draws d(2,4)=6, d(2,4)=8, rn2(9)=1, then burnarmor draws and reports a tower of flame and the cloak smouldering.
callers: hack.c:spoteffects -> trap.c:dotrap -> trapeffect_selector -> trapeffect_fire_trap(hero) calls dofiretrap(NULL); js/trap_effects.js:preflight_dotrap currently refuses FIRE_TRAP before this path.
trap.c:mintrap -> trapeffect_selector -> trapeffect_fire_trap(monster) is already ported; trap.c:trapeffect_magic_trap can return this monster arm status.
trap.c:domagictrap fate 12 calls dofiretrap(NULL); its JavaScript path currently refuses this fire effect.
trap.c:chest_trap fire outcomes 9-12 call dofiretrap(box); JavaScript currently records an unported gap.
dependencies: trap.c:trapeffect_fire_trap consumes the integer result of its existing monster arm; preserve its source return values while wiring the hero arm.

js/trap_erode_obj.js:burnarmor returns the boolean consumed before rn2(3). js/zap_destroy_items.js:burn_floor_objects returns the boolean consumed before the blind smell message; destroy_items is a void effect.

js/attrib.js:minuhpmax and setuhpmax, js/mondata.js:monstseesu and monstunseesu, js/apply_catch_lit.js:ignite_items, and existing damage/erosion helpers are available; trace their state and RNG order.
Void/display helpers shieldeff and melt_ice and the wet-towel dry_a_towel path need source review; record exact allowed gaps only where C discards the result.
